The following events happened in '''220 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] Industrial Age began.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
*A [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] vessel crash-landed on the planet [[Holador]], and its surviving crew formed a colony.<ref name="STR">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Strike III}}</ref>
*The family [[Solis]], an [[FIII Footman droid]], was serving was attacked, betrayed, and murdered.<ref name="FIII">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
